title: Aries — What the Stars Reveal Today
script_text:
Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now.
A fiery drive fuels you as Mars forms a square to Saturn in your 7th House, stirring partnership tension and testing confidence.
Meanwhile, Venus sextiles your 10th House for smoother career talks, while a Jupiter trine in your 2nd House brings an unexpected windfall.
In love, the Venus sextile ignites dialogue with your partner, yet the Mars-Saturn square warns against impulsive arguments.
If you're single, a charismatic neighbor catches your eye as Mercury conjoins your 5th House, sparking a flirtatious spark.
Your career soars with the Jupiter trine, and the planet may bring a promotion opportunity, but beware of overextending in the 8th House.
Skip any rash relationship declarations under the Mars-Saturn stress, welcome a surprising creative breakthrough.
Follow for tomorrow's reading so you stay ahead of the celestial shifts.
